not_a_verdict: no feature is ruled SEARCHABLE or NOT_SEARCHABLE here. That belongs to the prespecified support floor.

CISD_MASK_IDENTITY.meaning: all four share one frozen validity contract, so availability, position and pair support are identical by construction; only fire counts differ

CISD_PREFIX_STRUCTURE.right_censoring: the 7 securities with no observed gap are recorded as NO_GAP_OBSERVED, not assigned an artificial first-gap time at the Massive end date
CISD_PREFIX_STRUCTURE.reading: every security has SOME valid CISD, but the median valid prefix is 4 bars / 1 session. "any_valid = 476" is therefore a misleading headline on its own.

HOLDOUT.fire_rate: 0.0000% — a TRUE zero, not UNAVAILABLE: 2,184 valid opportunities existed and none fired

CISD_DEV_VS_HOLDOUT.semantics_note: the zero-denominator case did NOT arise here. Had valid_rows been 0 the correct report would be UNAVAILABLE / N.A., never 0%.

CISD_CONCENTRATION_DEV.reading: the 3.50% does not live spread across the universe. Roughly 48 securities carry 96.6% of all valid CISD observations and 20 carry 74.1%. For search purposes this is a small-cohort feature wearing a full-universe label.

WLNBB_HOLDOUT.stability: fire rates are close to DEV across every column (l34 10.28 vs 10.06, bo_up 7.93 vs 7.71, be_up 3.40 vs 3.18, bx_up 1.68 vs 1.58) — descriptive only, no inference drawn

WLNBB_CONCENTRATION_DEV.reading: the anchored columns are roughly twice as concentrated as the bounded ones, consistent with the L43 anchor being available mainly on well-covered securities

EFFECTIVE_SURFACE_TOPOLOGY.summary: Stage C features do not share one evidence surface

ladder.CISD x4: 3.50% valid, but 96.6% of it in 10% of securities, and 7 securities in HOLDOUT

EFFECTIVE_SURFACE_TOPOLOGY.conclusion: grouping these twelve as "stateful features" concealed four materially different evidence surfaces

CISD_INTERPRETATION_GUARD: CISD is semantically producible under the frozen new-Massive measurement regime. It is NOT declared unusable here. What is established: only 3.50% of bars are AVAILABLE_VALID because state cannot be recovered after the first interior contamination, that support is highly concentrated, and the historical holdout retains 7 securities with zero fires.
